      "scenario": "The reporting team has standing access to the same bucket that holds full, unencrypted nightly database backups. Anyone on that team (or anyone who compromises one of their accounts) can open and read the entire raw database dump, not just the reporting dataset they're supposed to see, exposing every table including sensitive customer data.",
      "component": "Cloud storage bucket",
      "likelihood": 4,

        { "quote": "The bucket is shared with the reporting team." }

        "title": "Restrict backup bucket access to backup/restore roles only",
        "given": "Nightly database backups are stored in cloud storage",
        "when": "A team or service does not need full database contents",
        "then": "That team must not have read access to the raw backup bucket; reporting must use a separate, scoped dataset"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "InformationDisclosure",
      "title": "Backups stored in plaintext expose all data if bucket access is leaked or misconfigured",
      "scenario": "Because 'the backup files are not encrypted', anyone who obtains bucket credentials, finds a misconfigured public ACL, or gains any read access to the storage bucket (including via the shared reporting access) can read complete, plaintext copies of production data with no additional barrier.",

      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "The backup files are not encrypted." },
        { "quote": "Database backups are written nightly to a cloud storage bucket." }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V8.1.5", "V8.1.1"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-311"],
      "plainLanguage": "The backups aren't locked with encryption, so anyone who gets into the storage bucket can read everything in plain text.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Encrypt backups at rest",
        "given": "Database backups are written to cloud storage",
        "when": "A backup file is created",
        "then": "It must be encrypted at rest with a key the backup bucket viewers do not automatically have, so bucket access alone is not enough to read the data"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "ElevationOfPrivilege",
      "title": "Shared bucket grants reporting team a path to escalate beyond reporting data",
      "scenario": "The reporting team's legitimate need is reporting data, but because the bucket is shared, a malicious or compromised reporting account gets access to full database backups which may include admin credentials, internal secrets, or other tables that let it escalate privileges elsewhere in the system.",
      "component": "Reporting team access",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "The bucket is shared with the reporting team." },
        { "quote": "Database backups are written nightly to a cloud storage bucket." }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V8.3.4"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-269"],
      "plainLanguage": "Giving the reporting team the full backup bucket could hand them (or an attacker who hacks their account) far more access than reporting needs, like admin secrets.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Apply least privilege to backup bucket sharing",
        "given": "A team needs only a subset of backed-up data",
        "when": "Bucket access is granted",
        "then": "Access must be scoped to only the data that team needs, not the full raw backup set"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "Tampering",
      "title": "Unencrypted, unsigned backups can be modified undetected before a restore",
      "scenario": "Since backups are unencrypted and shared with a second team, there's no integrity protection described. An attacker or malicious insider with bucket write access could alter a backup file; if that backup is later restored, corrupted or backdoored data (e.g. a fake admin row) would silently enter production.",
      "component": "Cloud storage bucket",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "The backup files are not encrypted." },
        { "quote": "The bucket is shared with the reporting team." }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V8.1.4"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-345"],
      "plainLanguage": "Nothing stops someone with bucket access from secretly editing a backup file, which could poison data when it's restored later.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Verify backup integrity before restore",
        "given": "A backup file is restored to the database",
        "when": "The restore process runs",
        "then": "It must verify a checksum or signature created at backup time and reject the restore if it does not match"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "DenialOfService",
      "title": "Shared write access lets the reporting team disrupt backup availability",
      "scenario": "If bucket sharing also grants delete/overwrite permissions, a reporting team account error or compromise could delete or overwrite recent nightly backups, removing the organization's ability to recover the database when it's actually needed.",
      "component": "Cloud storage bucket",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "The bucket is shared with the reporting team." },
        { "quote": "Database backups are written nightly to a cloud storage bucket." }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V8.3.4"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-284"],
      "plainLanguage": "If the reporting team can also delete or overwrite backups, a mistake or hack on their side could wipe out the organization's recovery copies.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Make shared bucket access read-only and separate from write/delete rights",
        "given": "Backups are shared for reporting purposes",
        "when": "Access is granted to a non-backup team",
        "then": "That access must be read-only on a scoped subset, never delete or overwrite rights on the backup store"
      }
    }
  ]
}
